meta.title: Creative studio in Tallinn | ARTlab
meta.description: ARTlab is a creative studio for children and adults in Tallinn, offering art, creative workshops, handicrafts, group classes and private lessons.

hero.title: A creative studio for children and adults.
hero.description: Our studio's main focus is visual art. We introduce children and adults to a variety of artistic techniques, teach them to see colour, form and composition, work with different materials and gradually discover their own style.
hero.imageAlt: ARTlab's bright creative studio with worktables and easels

approach.title: More than a beautiful result.
approach.description: For us, creativity is an opportunity to explore, imagine and experiment, to develop your imagination and become more confident in your own ideas.
approach.accent: In every class, we provide a clear foundation and the skills you need, demonstrate techniques and guide you through each stage of the process, while always leaving room for imagination and individual creative choices. This is why even with a shared theme, every piece turns out uniquely personal.

team.title: Teachers who support every step of the process.
team.description: They explain things calmly, help students understand the materials and encourage every participant's own ideas.

marina.name: Marina Volodina
marina.role: Founder and Director of the ART Lab creative studio
marina.imageAlt: Marina Volodina, founder and director of the ART Lab creative studio
biography: My journey in art began at art school. Later, I chose a path where science and the heart meet: two university degrees, a master's degree in psychology, and now methods for teaching painting to children. To me, these are not simply a collection of qualifications, but a way to become a teacher who truly knows how to listen.

Every child arrives with their own personality, their own pace and their own small fears of the blank page. For some, one encouraging word is enough; others need time simply to become comfortable with paint. I am there to explain, demonstrate and let them try for themselves — and to celebrate the moment when a child finds their own solution.

ART Lab grew from a dream of creating a space where everyone can simply be themselves. The studio was founded during a difficult time, which may be why it matters so much to me that it feels warm and calm. A place to forget about what one ‘must’ do and what is ‘correct’, become absorbed in the process and discover something new within oneself.

I continue to study so that I can give students more than individual techniques — I want to give them a foundation for seeing form, colour, light and composition. Even more importantly, I want every child to leave feeling: ‘I was heard. My ideas matter. I can do this.’

ekaterina.name: Ekaterina
ekaterina.imageAlt: Visual arts teacher Ekaterina at the ART Lab creative studio
biography: I trained as an artist and art educator. I taught visual arts at school for many years and continue to pursue my own creative practice. Painting is closest to me, but I also work with movement, sound and other forms of art.

In class, it is important to me to help each person learn to see: to notice colour, form, light and the mood they want to convey in their work. I explain artistic techniques and support students as they try something new and search for their own solution.

In my own practice, I explore how movement and sound influence our perception. It reminds me that art always leaves room for discovery. I want students to feel that same freedom, enjoy the process and gradually find their own artistic language.

elena.name: Marina Zaboronok
elena.imageAlt: Visual arts and handicrafts teacher Marina Zaboronok at the ART Lab creative studio
biography: I trained as a decorative artist and am also a skilled craft maker. For many years, I have worked with different materials and techniques, created things by hand and led creative classes for children. I enjoy sharing this experience and showing just how many interesting things can be made from the simplest materials.

In class, I introduce children to drawing and handicrafts, explain every stage and help them bring their own ideas to life. It is important to me that children are not afraid to try, learn to work carefully, notice details and gradually become more independent. That is why, even when everyone shares the same theme, each child creates a unique piece of their own.

I value a calm and friendly atmosphere where children feel comfortable asking questions and experimenting. I love seeing a child become absorbed in the process, discover an unexpected solution and proudly show what they have made with their own hands.

I find inspiration in nature, flowers, gardening and bicycle rides. I want to help children notice the beauty around them and turn their observations and imagination into drawings and handmade pieces. I also want them to leave class with that special feeling: ‘I came up with this myself. I did it!’

directions.title: A creative path for everyone.
directions.description: Focus on drawing, combine art with three-dimensional techniques, or make beautiful things by hand.

items.title: Visual art
items.description: ARTlab's main direction for children and adults: drawing and exploring colour, form, composition and a wide range of artistic materials.

items.title: Creative workshop 4+
items.description: A space for children who enjoy making as much as drawing: plasticine art, appliqué, decoupage, art collage, three-dimensional projects and mixed media.

items.title: Handicraft club
items.description: Beading, macramé, knitting and other handcraft techniques. Children create their own jewellery, accessories, toys and decorative pieces.

formats.title: Group and private lessons.
formats.description: We will help you choose a format where you can learn comfortably, try new things and progress at your own pace.

items.title: Small groups
items.description: Classes take place in small groups, allowing the teacher to give personal attention to every participant.

items.title: Private lessons
items.description: The programme and pace are tailored to each student's age, interests and creative goals.

closing.accent: fall in love with creativity from the very first minute.
